purpose: Decide whether conditional SGLN may be admitted only as a capped fourth portfolio sleeve.
method: Use SQ native daily mark-to-market equity for every component.
Replace SQ's currency-neutral SGLN PnL with whole-share GBP PnL converted daily using as-of ECB GBPUSD.
Deduct a complete estimated round-trip cost on each entry date, which is conservative before the actual exit.
Do not change signals, parameters, sizing, dates, assets, or the three cost scenarios after seeing this result.
interpretation: PASS admits SGLN as a capped portfolio diversifier only. It does not promote SGLN to a standalone consolidated strategy.
